Light of variable frequency shines on the metal surface of a photoelectric tube. Einstein’s theory of the photoelectric effect predicts that the
Option A: work function of the metal is proportional to the frequency
Option B: work function of the metal is proportional to the wavelength
Option C: current in the tube is a linear function of the wavelength
Option D: potential difference necessary to stop the emitted electrons is a linear function of the frequency above the threshold frequency
